about.desc_1: At <0>La Favorita Interiores</0> we develop custom kitchen, wardrobe, walk-in closet and furniture projects in Tenerife.
about.desc_2: We study every home through its layout, its proportions and its everyday use to propose solutions that make sense both visually and practically.
about.sub_title: Everything starts with a good layout
about.sub_desc_1: Before choosing colours or finishes, we solve the essentials: circulation, storage capacity, heights, openings, appliance integration and the relationship between every element.
about.sub_desc_2: From there, we define materials, textures and lighting to achieve a balanced, clean result that is consistent with the architecture of the home.
about.quote: Knowing what works, what to avoid and how to carry every decision through to the last detail.

hero.title: The passion that inspires
hero.subtitle: Experience, judgment, and a very personal way of working
hero.p1: Behind La Favorita Interiores is Patricia, who personally accompanies each project from the first conversation.
hero.p2: Her way of working starts with listening. Without rushed meetings or decisions made in a hurry. She dedicates the necessary time to understand what each client needs, what worries them, what they want to change, and how they actually use their home.
hero.p3: When the project requires it, she personally accompanies clients to the factory so they can get to know the materials, see finishes, compare options, and better understand how their furniture will be produced. Because choosing from a small sample is not always enough. Patricia is closely involved in every step of the process, resolving doubts, proposing alternatives, and helping make decisions with peace of mind. That closeness allows each project to move forward with clear communication and a much more direct relationship. For us, attending well does not simply mean responding quickly. It means being available, listening carefully, and giving each project the time it really needs.

mission.title: OUR WAY OF WORKING
mission.description: We like to do things with time and good judgment. We want each client to understand exactly what they are choosing and feel supported throughout the process. That is why we listen, explain the options, review each decision, and never rush to close a project before it is well defined. From the first conversation to a visit to the factory or the choice of a finish, we aim for the client to decide with information, calm, and confidence.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: Growing without losing closeness. We want La Favorita Interiores to keep growing without becoming a distant company. Maintaining a personal approach, dedicating time to each client, accompanying them when they need to see materials or visit the factory, and remaining present in the important decisions of the project. Growing, yes. But without losing the way of working that defines us.

items.text: We do not start by showing catalogues. First, we want to understand what you need, what is not working right now, and what you hope to achieve.
A meeting may last as long as it needs to. We prefer to resolve doubts and make good decisions rather than speed up a process that requires attention.
When useful, we accompany the client to the factory to see materials, finishes, and solutions in person. There are decisions that are understood much better when they can be touched and compared.
We explain possibilities, limitations, and alternatives directly. If we believe something can be resolved better another way, we say so.
Patricia maintains direct contact throughout the process so that the decisions made at the beginning are respected until installation.
Every project begins by listening to your ideas and understanding how you want to live in your space.
We do not believe in standard solutions. Each project is developed in a personalized way to adapt to you and your home.
We respect the agreed deadlines and take care of each phase of the process with the same level of dedication and high standards.
We constantly evolve to incorporate new trends, materials, and solutions that bring greater value to each project.

remote_design.title: If you can't come,
remote_design.subtitle: It is not always possible to travel to our shop. That is why we can also keep the first meetings by video call and move forward with you on much of the project without needing to be physically here.
remote_design.description: From photographs, measurements, and information about the home, we can study the starting point, discuss alternatives, and prepare the proposal. Afterwards, you can review the layout and the 3D visualization directly with us. When the time comes to choose finishes or carry out technical checks, we will coordinate the best way to continue with you.
items: Joint review of plans and layout.
Direct follow-up during the different phases.

cocinas-a-medida.title: Custom Kitchens
cocinas-a-medida.subtitle: SPECIALISTS IN BESPOKE KITCHENS IN TENERIFE
cocinas-a-medida.description: A well-resolved kitchen starts long before choosing the color of the doors. We analyze the layout, installations, heights, circulation routes and storage capacity to define a composition that works correctly within the home.
paragraphs: We develop the layout, modulation, appliance integration, interior fittings, lighting and finish selection. The furniture is produced in the factory according to the project specifications and is installed with careful attention to measurements, alignment and finishes.

When the architecture requires it, we adjust backgrounds, heights, columns, closures and joints to avoid forced solutions. The goal is for the kitchen to make the most of the space while maintaining a clean and proportionate visual reading.

Each kitchen is planned from the existing architecture, the installations and the way it will actually be used. We define the composition before entering the finishes, so that each element has a reason to exist.

armarios-a-medida.title: Custom Wardrobes
armarios-a-medida.subtitle: Bespoke wardrobes and dressing rooms
armarios-a-medida.description: A good wardrobe is not defined only by its exterior appearance. The difference lies in how it is organized inside, how much useful space it offers and whether it truly responds to what you need to store.
paragraphs: We study heights, depths, access points and usage patterns to distribute rails, drawers, shelves, shoe storage and accessories in a logical way. Each interior is configured according to the intended contents, avoiding standard compartments that end up being underused.

For fronts and openings, we choose the most suitable solution according to the available space: hinged, sliding or flush doors, integrated into the architecture and coordinated with the rest of the room.

muebles-a-medida.subtitle: CUSTOM FURNITURE FOR DIFFERENT AREAS OF THE HOME
muebles-a-medida.description: There are spaces that are not solved well by conventional furniture. Difficult gaps, full-height walls, changes in depth or specific storage needs require a piece designed from the outset for that exact location.
paragraphs: We design furniture for living rooms, hallways, bedrooms, dining rooms, work areas, and other environments, adjusting proportions, capacity, and composition to the existing architecture.
We can integrate lighting, doors, display cases, drawers, shelving, wall paneling, and other elements into the same composition to achieve a cleaner and better-used overall arrangement.

soluciones-inteligentes.title: Smart Solutions
soluciones-inteligentes.subtitle: Technology and automation for modern furniture
soluciones-inteligentes.description: We incorporate smart technology into your furniture to create more comfortable, functional, efficient, and elegant spaces where design and innovation coexist naturally.
paragraphs: We integrate smart home solutions that improve your daily life, such as automatic LED lighting, electric opening systems, hidden sockets, and intelligent mechanisms that provide greater comfort, optimize space, and facilitate every task.

Each project is tailored to your needs to offer a more practical, intuitive, and sophisticated experience, integrating technology discreetly and harmoniously in custom kitchens, wardrobes, and furniture.

cortinas-pergolas.title: Solar control for indoor and outdoor spaces
cortinas-pergolas.subtitle: SOLAR CONTROL FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR SPACES
cortinas-pergolas.description: Controlling the amount of sunlight that enters drastically changes how a home is used. We select and install solar protection systems considering orientation, the dimensions of each opening, and the level of light or privacy required.
paragraphs: For interiors, we work with custom-made curtains and blinds with different levels of filtering and options for manual or motorized operation. On terraces and outdoor areas, we incorporate pergolas that extend the hours of use and create protected spaces against direct sun exposure.
When the project requires it, motors, lighting and control systems can be planned from the start to achieve a cleaner and more integrated installation.

item1.question: Are the kitchens custom-made or pre-designed models?
item1.p1: We design and manufacture kitchens <0>100% custom-made</0>. Although we have inspiring concepts and layout references as a starting point, each project is designed from scratch to adapt with total precision to the architecture of your home and your daily routines.
item1.p2: We do not limit ourselves to fitting standard catalog modules. We meticulously plan the storage capacity of each area, the interior configuration of drawers and pull-outs, the direction of opening doors, advanced hardware systems, height ergonomics and overall proportions.
item1.p3: Your kitchen is created to actually work in your house, not to meet the standards of a predefined catalog.

item2.question: What does the project include?
item2.header: We offer a <0>comprehensive turnkey service</0> that covers from the initial idea to the final finish:
item2.li1: <0>Consultation and Concept:</0> We meet to understand your lifestyle, usage needs and aesthetic preferences.
item2.li2: <0>Technical Measurement:</0> We perform an exact and professional in-situ measurement to avoid any margin of error.
item2.li3: <0>3D Design and Visualization:</0> We prepare a realistic three-dimensional proposal so you can see and perfect the kitchen before starting production.
item2.li4: <0>Manufacturing and Installation:</0> We produce each piece to high standards and install it using our team of specialized installers for a millimeter-perfect fit.

item3.question: How long will I be without a kitchen during the installation?
item3.p1: We minimize transition times to mitigate inconvenience in your daily life. The installation is meticulously planned in advance, coordinating delivery and assembly times efficiently.
item3.p2: Our goal is to make the process fast, organized and clean, allowing you to enjoy your new kitchen in the shortest possible time without compromising high precision in the finishes.

item4.question: What brands do you work with?
item4.header: We exclusively select top-tier brands that guarantee durability, ergonomics and resistance to continuous daily use:

box1.title: Surfaces and Countertops
box1.text: We work with high-end and highly durable countertops such as <0>Silestone</0>, <1>Dekton</1>, <2>Corian Solid Surface</2> and <3>Compac</3>.

box2.title: Mobiliario y Acabados
box2.text: We use advanced technology panels from <0>Alvic</0> to achieve impeccable finishes and front panels resistant to wear.

box3.title: Hardware and Systems
box3.text: We equip our modules with systems from the Austrian firm <0>Blum</0>, recognized for the smoothness and soft-closing in drawers and doors.

box4.title: Appliances
box4.text: We integrate equipment adapted to your kitchen style with trusted brands such as <0>Bosch</0>, <1>Siemens</1>, <2>Franke</2>, <3>Teka</3>, <4>Balay</4> and <5>Fagor</5>.

item4.note: * The final selection is defined in a personalized way during the project phase based on design, technical requirements and budget.

item5.question: What happens if I need an adjustment or a problem arises with the kitchen?
item5.p1: Your long-term peace of mind is our priority. If over time you need to recalibrate a door, check the sliding of a drawer or correct a soft-close system, our after-sales service will take care of resolving it.
item5.p2: In addition, all components and countertops have their corresponding official warranty, managed directly by our team to avoid intermediaries and inconvenience.

item6.question: How does financing work?
item6.p1: We offer attractive flexible financing options of up to <0>60 months</0> so you can accommodate the payment of your project with total comfort. This facility is subject to approval by the collaborating financial entity.
item6.p2: We explain all conditions transparently and without fine print at the time of delivering the detailed quote, ensuring that everything is perfectly defined before starting.
